mapper.select: /** help-mapper.getFrontHelpListCount (도움말 목록 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_MNL M

/** help-mapper.getFrontHelpList (도움말 목록 조회) */
SELECT M.MNL_SN, M.MENU_SE_CODE, M.MENU_URL, M.MENU_NM, M.FILE_NM, M.ORGINL_FILE_NM, M.FILE_TY, M.INQIRE_CO, M.MENU_SJ, M.MENU_CN, M.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(M.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, M.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(M.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_MNL M
ORDER BY
M.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM M.INQIRE_CO M.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM
ASC DESC
M.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/** help-mapper.getFrontHelpDetail (도움말 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.mnl_sn, A.menu_se_code, A.menu_url, A.menu_nm, A.file_nm, A.orginl_file_nm, A.file_ty, A.inqire_co, A.menu_sj, A.menu_cn, A.frst_register_id, A.frst_regist_pnttm, A.last_updusr_id, A.last_updt_pnttm, A.user_name AS user_name FROM ( SELECT M.mnl_sn, M.menu_se_code, M.menu_url, M.menu_nm, M.file_nm, M.orginl_file_nm, M.file_ty, M.inqire_co, M.menu_sj, M.menu_cn, M.frst_register_id, DATE_FORMAT(M.frst_regist_pnttm,'%Y-%m-%d') AS frst_regist_pnttm, M.last_updusr_id, DATE_FORMAT(M.last_updt_pnttm,'%Y-%m-%d') AS last_updt_pnttm, IFNULL(MG.user_name, U.user_name) AS user_name FROM g_mnl M LEFT OUTER JOIN op_manager MG ON IFNULL(M.last_updusr_id, M.frst_register_id) = MG.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN op_user U ON IFNULL(M.last_updusr_id, M.frst_register_id) = U.user_id WHERE M.mnl_sn = #{mnlSn} ) A
mapper.update: /** help-mapper.addHitCount (조회수 증가) */ UPDATE G_MNL SET INQIRE_CO = INQIRE_CO + 1 WHERE MNL_SN = #{mnlSn}
mapper.select: /** help-mapper.getFrontHelpFileInfo (도움말 파일 정보 조회) */ SELECT M.MNL_SN, M.MENU_SE_CODE, C.LABEL AS MENU_URL, C.DETAIL AS MENU_NM, M.FILE_NM, M.ORGINL_FILE_NM, M.FILE_TY, M.INQIRE_CO, M.MENU_SJ, M.MENU_CN, M.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(M.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, M.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(M.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_MNL M INNER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = 'MENU_URL' AND C.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.ID = M.MENU_SE_CODE AND C.LABEL = #{menuUrl} LIMIT 1
